scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && spago build -p halogen-store-examples --pedantic-packages && npm run examples && npm run format:check
scripts.examples: npm run examples:basic && npm run examples:basic-no-action && npm run examples:redux-todo && npm run examples:basic-hooks
scripts.examples:basic: spago bundle -p halogen-store-examples --bundle-type app --platform browser --module Basic.Main --outfile basic/app.js
scripts.examples:basic-no-action: spago bundle -p halogen-store-examples --bundle-type app --platform browser --module NoAction.Main --outfile basic-no-action/app.js
scripts.examples:redux-todo: spago bundle -p halogen-store-examples --bundle-type app --platform browser --module ReduxTodo.Main --outfile redux-todo/app.js
scripts.examples:basic-hooks: spago bundle -p halogen-store-examples --bundle-type app --platform browser --module Hooks.Main --outfile basic-hooks/app.js
